verdict=preserved: The revision tightens wording and restructures sentences, but keeps the two-stage model, the 8.3-point accuracy gain over the Koren et al. (2009) matrix factorization baseline, the warm-start engagement finding, and the single-platform limitation at the same strength and scope. Dropping 'the results point out that' and joining the limitation and future-work sentences with 'so' are an attribution-verb change and a connective, so neither is reported.
